show.description: On a speeding train, a wounded young woman is brutally humiliated, branded a gold-digger, and nearly killed by a ruthless billionaire family—until a shocking truth explodes: the “helpless” girl they tortured is actually the only daughter of the powerful tycoon they’re desperate to marry into.
